test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Anant's mother advised him to not sleep under the trees at night as trees release ______ at night.
solution:
The correct answer is __**release of carbon dioxide.**__

__
 
• The **carbon dioxide** that is produced during **human respiration** reaches the empty spaces within the leaves and simultaneously photosynthesis is going on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Due to this, **carbon dioxide **present in the air is used and **consumed by the plants**.
 
• Thus during the day, plants produce oxygen while **consuming carbon dioxide but at the night the process of photosynthesis stops but respiration continues for plants.**
 
 
• Meaning that **oxygen is not produced by the plants at night.**
 
 
 
• Because of this **natural phenomenon, **it is advised that at night if you sleep under the tree, you will not get oxygen, which can cause **breathing problems, suffocation, etc.**
